title: Bus Rides for Sleep
description: Bus announcements, driver's voice, route info for sleep. The bus stop as lullaby. Local stops, route numbers, next stop announcements.
concept: Bus announcements + road ambiance = the whole video. Driver announcing stops, route info, next stop. Per city, accurate local style. More intimate than trains — smaller vehicle, closer voice.

structure: 1. Route announcement — 'This is route X to DESTINATION'
3. Stop announcement — 'This stop is STOP NAME'
4. Connection info — 'Change here for routes Y and Z'
5. Driver commentary — 'We are now traveling along STREET NAME'

london.voice_style: Clear, efficient, London accent. 'This is route 73 to Victoria Station'
phrases: This is route X to DESTINATION
This stop is STOP NAME. Change here for the TUBE
london.ambience: Road noise, engine hum, doors hissing, rain on roof

tokyo.voice_style: Polite, formal, Japanese. 'Tsugi wa, STOP NAME desu'
phrases: Maigo no basu wa TOEN desu
tokyo.ambience: Road noise, gentle engine, departure melody, rain

new_york.voice_style: Direct, New York accent. 'Next stop, Broadway and 42nd Street'
new_york.ambience: City traffic, engine rumble, doors opening, street sounds

berlin.ambience: City sounds, bus engine, doors, rain
